claims.claim: Nvidia board opened an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he acknowledged an intimate relationship with a business executive assessed by U.S. intelligence as a Chinese spy.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia investors should review governance exposure after board launches independent probe into CEO Huang.
claims.source_title: Nvidia board opens independent probe into Jensen Huang over foreign intel reports
claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia's board has opened an independent investigation into Jensen Huang after reports he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort, while saying it has no reason to believe company secrets were compromised.

claims.claim: Fed Governor Waller revised his neutral rate estimate higher and stated the policy stance is not as tight as thought 18 months ago.
claims.episode_span: Fed Governor Waller revised his neutral rate estimate higher and warned that three straight 0.3 percent core CPI prints would annualize at 3.5 percent inflation, keeping a December hike on the table even if October data improves.
claims.source_title: Fed's Waller Revises Up Neutral Rate Estimate
claims.supporting_quote: Waller says he's revised up his estimate of the neutral rate of interest: "In that sense, we're not as tight as I thought we might have been 18 months ago."
